tools.name: list_archetypes
tools.description: Lists the 13 EA SPORTS FC 27 Pro Clubs archetypes with their positions, both Signature PlayStyles, Specializations and base AcceleRATE. Optionally filter by position group (goalkeeper, defender, midfielder, forward) or by a position such as ST, CAM or CB.

tools.name: get_archetype
tools.description: Full FC 27 Pro Clubs data for one archetype: starting value, cap and AP cost tier of every attribute, skill moves and weak foot, Signature PlayStyles and Perks, and each Specialization with its targets and AP cost (Season 2 prices, level cap 55).

tools.name: calculate_build_cost
tools.description: Calculates the Attribute Points (AP) an FC 27 Pro Clubs archetype needs to reach target attribute values from its starting stats, the first level that has that many AP (cap 55 = 1,419 AP), which Specializations the targets unlock, and a Build Planner link with the targets loaded.

tools.name: list_specializations
tools.description: Lists FC 27 Pro Clubs Specializations with the PlayStyle+ each gives, its three attribute targets and the AP to unlock it from the starting stats, cheapest first. All 39, or only those of one archetype.

tools.name: get_level_progression
tools.description: FC 27 Pro Clubs archetype levels: AP gained at each level, running total and unlocks (PlayStyle slots, Signature Perks, PlayStyle+ upgrades, Masteries). The level cap is 55 (1,419 AP) since Season 2. Give a level for one row, or nothing for the whole table.

tools.name: check_accelerate_type
tools.description: Works out the FC 27 Pro Clubs AcceleRATE type (Explosive, Controlled or Lengthy) from height and the Acceleration, Agility and Strength a Pro has in the match, and lists which conditions pass or fail. Explosive: 182 cm or shorter, Agility 65+, Agility 10 above Strength, Acceleration 80+.

tools.name: get_archetype_meta
tools.description: Archetype usage among players of the top 100 FC 27 Pro Clubs on EA’s all-time leaderboard (PRO11 snapshot): share of players, average match rating, goals and assists per match and median height. Shows how old the snapshot is.

tools.name: list_formations
tools.description: Lists the formations available in FC 27 Clubs tactics with their positions, or one formation by name (for example "4-1-2-1-2 Narrow"). Links to the PRO11 tactics board and the attacking and defensive formation guides.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Searches PRO11’s EA SPORTS FC 27 Pro Clubs guides (builds, positions, tactics, settings, Playoffs, patch notes, names) and returns titles, summaries and links. Use for questions the other tools don’t cover.
